name: HasFDerivWithinAt.lim
statement: HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x) {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} {c : α → 𝕜} {d : α → E} {v : E} (dlim : Tendsto d l (𝓝 0)) (dtop : ∀ᶠ n in l, x + d n ∈ s) (cdlim : Tendsto (fun n => c n • d n) l (𝓝 v)) : Tendsto (fun n => c n • (f (x + d n) - f x)) l (𝓝 (f' v))

name: HasStrictFDerivAt.exists_lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_lt
statement: HasStrictFDerivAt f f' x) (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : ‖f'‖₊ < K) : ∃ s ∈ 𝓝 x, LipschitzOnWith K f s
